entry.name: showTime
entry.label: Show the time in the panel

entry.name: timeFormat
entry.label: Qt time format for the panel (empty = locale's short format)

entry.name: showDate
entry.label: Show the date in the panel

entry.name: dateFormat
entry.label: Qt date format for the panel (empty = locale's short format)

entry.name: datePosition
entry.label: Where the date goes relative to the time (before, after or below)

entry.name: panelFontFamily
entry.label: Font family for the panel text (empty = theme font)

entry.name: panelFontSize
entry.label: Font size in points for the panel time (0 = automatic)

entry.name: panelFontWeight
entry.label: Font weight for the panel time (100 = thin ... 900 = black)

entry.name: showWeekNumbers
entry.label: Show ISO week numbers in the calendar
